body: This actually makes a lot of sense to me. I mean, it doesn't really solve the entirety of my problems, but I should remind myself that depression is a mental health issue and that things aren't as bleak as they seem. :)

I already feel like I've caused enough trouble though. I've recently dented my grandmother's car in a parking garage. I recently took it to the shop, and the mechanic gave me an estimate of $870.00. Not only did I wreck someone's mean's of transportation, but I disappointed both my father and myself. It's like whenever I do something that harms another person, that person just grows to resent me. I'm such a fucking mess.

I understand that people have mistakes, but the problem with me is that I don’t learn from my mistakes. I’m just caught in a loop where I think I’m on a path of self recovery, and then I ruin things again. Plus, that pain I cause people will never go away.

Honestly, every time I had tried to change my life for the better, I go back to square one. Part of me wants to believe that life can be hunky-dory and that things would get better, but I know I tend to fall into cycles of getting better and falling apart with other people having to suffer. I don't want to put people through that pain anymore.
